beta.scope: Each product and scenario, summed over customers and all 60 periods
beta.meaning: Minimum delivered fraction of delta_D-scaled domestic demand; not a probability

alpha.scope: Each product and scenario, summed over export destinations and all 60 periods
alpha.denominator: Sum of exogenous supply for the same product, scenario and horizon
alpha.meaning: Upper exported fraction; no export minimum; original destination-period upper bounds retained

design.kind: Staged controlled contrasts, then selected interactions; not global sensitivity indices
design.interaction_levels: Choose from first-stage evidence after separate approval
design.resource_budget: Not assigned; no queue, job or execution authorization

absolute_fixed_costs: Remain zero; positive values require empirical basis and approval
level_basis: Researcher-review diagnostic perturbations, not calibrated uncertainty or confidence intervals
